dct_description_sm: Georeferenced GeoTIFF raster dataset for Boulder City, 1952. The raster has 1 band and dimensions of 4,301 x 3,849 pixels. The source package includes the TIFF dataset with associated TFW, AUX, and RRD sidecar files. Coordinate reference system detected by GDAL: NAD83 / UTM zone 11N (EPSG:26911).
gbl_displayNote_sm: Source ZIP contains bouldercity1952.tif with .tfw, .aux, and .rrd sidecar files.
